items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Oh yeah. Jerry Dodgion is a nice guy. See I had them all in this band.

ctx.x: Nice names. I’m a saxophone player myself.
